game.remember-each-board-s-starting-posi: Remember each board’s starting position. Once the dots disappear, mentally move the indicated dot one square per arrow. Crossing an edge brings it in on the opposite side. Select each final position.
game.digits-appear-in-interleaved-stream: Digits appear in interleaved streams. Keep only the chosen number of latest digits in each stream. When the stream stops, enter each stream’s digits in their original order. Repeated digits are allowed.
game.remember-the-number-in-each-box-onc: Remember the number in each box. Once hidden, mentally apply +1 or −1 to the indicated box. Enter the final numbers; negative results are possible. Number keys and Backspace also work.
game.recall-the-latest-digits-in-each-st: Recall the latest digits in each stream

game.keep-track-of-the-highlighted-balls: Keep track of the highlighted balls as they move
game.remember-the-purple-balls-they-turn: Remember the purple balls. They turn gray and move with the others. When they stop, select the original targets and confirm. Click again to deselect.
game.start-by-tracking-1-target-increasi: Start by tracking 1 target, increasing to 5. Speed and motion duration keep increasing without a level cap. Recover every target to pass.
game.green-rings-show-the-original-targe: Green rings show the original targets
game.start-with-1-arrow-and-add-one-per-: Start with 1 arrow and add one per level, without a cap. Each character allows 5 seconds; each arrow appears for 1 second. All judgments and recalled arrows must be correct to pass. Levels are specific to this game, without standardized norms.
game.judge-symmetry-while-remembering-hi: Judge symmetry while remembering highlighted locations
game.judge-symmetry-then-remember-each-h: Judge symmetry, then remember each highlighted square. Recall the sequence in order; you can undo. Long sequences can repeat locations. Click a step number below the grid to review it.
game.start-with-1-square-and-add-one-eac: Start with 1 square and add one each level, without a cap. Beyond 16, locations may repeat. Recall the full sequence and make every decision correctly to pass. Each decision allows 4 seconds.
game.combine-flashes-judge-symmetry-reme: Combine flashes, judge symmetry, remember locations
game.combine-the-target-color-flashes-an: Combine the target-color flashes and judge top–bottom or left–right symmetry about the grid’s central axes. Choose Neither if neither applies; either symmetry answer is accepted when both apply. Then a square with a white inner border flashes twice: remember that location as one item. After several groups, recall the locations; repeats are allowed.
game.each-session-picks-two-of-eight-col: Each session picks two of eight colors and cues the target color. The other color appears when interference is enabled. Both stages share the same target color throughout the session. Reverse order and 90° clockwise or counterclockwise rotation apply only to the final location recall and can be combined.
game.start-with-1-memory-location-and-ad: Start with 1 memory location and add one each level, without a cap. All symmetry decisions and recalled locations must be correct to advance. Three failed levels end the game. Random mode independently chooses 2, 4 or 6 flashes for each pattern without announcing the length. You have 4 seconds once the decision buttons appear.

rules.timed: 30 seconds · First error ends the game · Score = correct answers
rules.choice: Choose the arrow direction by clicking, tapping, or pressing ← / →. Respond within 1.5 seconds; early or missed responses end the game.
rules.pvt: Click, tap, or press Space when the counter appears. An early response or no response within 10 seconds ends the game.
rules.gonogo: Respond to circles by click, tap, or Space; do not respond to squares. Each item lasts up to 1.5 seconds. Correct responses and successful withholding earn 1 point. Early, wrong, or missed responses end the game.
rules.schulte: Click in order for 30 seconds. One mistake ends the game. Completed grids are replaced; all correct clicks count.
rules.cancellation-hint: Wrong mark or missed target ends the game · Space: next page
rules.rotation-instructions: Mentally turn the rotated letter, digit, or symbol upright and decide whether it is mirrored. Then remember each arrow’s direction and length and recall them in order. Adjacent arrows are never identical.
rules.updating-progression: Start with 1 card and add one per level, with no level cap. All answers must be correct. Extra cards use additional pages.
rules.rotation-intro: Judge rotated characters and remember arrows
ui.local-result-kept-on-page: The local record is kept on this page for now.

cloud.rules-update-required: Scoring rules need updating. Refresh this page and retry. If it still fails, contact the site owner. Pending scores are retained.
mn.title: (M,N)-back
mn.description: Match several stimulus channels to N steps back
mn.instructions: Judge each enabled channel against N items earlier. Select all matches; select nothing if none match. Position is always enabled. M is the number of enabled channels.
mn.toggle-help: Each item appears for 400 ms, followed by (M + 1)/3 seconds to respond. Click to select or deselect; answers submit when the bar runs out. Audio always uses English letter names A–Z.
mn.scoring-help: Channels are scored together: F1 = 2 × hits ÷ (2 × hits + false alarms + misses). Shown as a percentage; higher is better. No selections score 0.
mn.audio-failed: Audio could not play. Check your audio settings and start again.
